ios.desc:
DoNotPay is your AI Consumer Champion. DoNotPay uses artificial intelligence to help you fight big corporations, protect your privacy, find hidden money, and beat bureaucracy.

---------

"DoNotPay is the hero the world needs." - TIME Magazine

“Shift agency back into the consumer’s hands.” - VICE

“Tomorrow’s consumer champion.” - Daily Mail

“Nifty innovation.” - The Sun 

---------
How does it work?

FIGHT CORPORATIONS: 

Let us know your problem and we will contact the corporation on your behalf. DoNotPay will also generate complaint letters for you and mail it on your behalf requesting the compensation you deserve.

MANAGE YOUR SUBSCRIPTIONS:

Find your forgotten and unwanted subscriptions and we’ll help cancel them for you! DoNotPay also offers a free trial card that you can use when signing up for free trials.

BURNER PHONES:

Create a single-use burner phone number to receive text messages and protect your privacy.

LOWER YOUR BILLS:

Let DoNotPay lower your bills for you. From medical bills, utility bills, to cell phone bills, simply send a picture of your bill and our expert negotiator will fight to get you a better rate or credits applied to your account.

FIND HIDDEN MONEY:

Whether it's an uncashed payroll check, forgotten dividends, or closed checking accounts, DoNotPay will locate any unclaimed property you may have under your name and claim it on your behalf. DoNotPay will also help you appeal bank fees. These fees can range from overdraft fees, late fees, interest fees, NSF fees and more!

BEAT BUREAUCRACY:

Appeal your parking and traffic tickets, schedule DMV appointments, make FOIA requests, and voice your concerns with government agencies. 

-------

Please email support@donotpay.com for questions, comments and concerns.

For our Terms of Service and to view our Privacy Policy, please visit DoNotPay.com/learn/terms-of-service/ and DoNotPay.com/learn/privacy-policy/.
